world.title: Satellite images show major construction surge at Iran’s underground Pickaxe site amid US war
world.summary: Satellite images reveal significant construction activity at Iran's underground Pickaxe nuclear site, located beneath a granite mountain. This surge in development has been observed in 2023, coinciding with ongoing conflicts in the region. The site is suspected of being involved in Iran's nuclear program, raising concerns among international observers regarding the implications for regional security and nuclear proliferation.

world.title: China-made tank explodes during Bangladesh army exercise, 2 soldiers killed
world.summary: A Type 59 tank exploded during a Bangladesh Army firing exercise in Chattogram, resulting in the deaths of two soldiers and serious injuries to an officer. The incident occurred at the Hathazari Field Firing Range on Wednesday. The Army is investigating the cause of the explosion, while the injured officer has been transported to Dhaka for treatment.

world.title: Pakistan orders medical colleges to expel Afghan students amid Kabul tensions
world.summary: Pakistan has mandated medical and dental colleges to expel Afghan students and cease new admissions due to deteriorating relations with Kabul. This decision, announced by a senior government official, intensifies pressure on Afghan nationals in Pakistan as deportations increase. The policy is expected to impact hundreds of Afghan students currently enrolled in these institutions across the country.

business.title: How a 60-Year-Old Collects $2,700 a Month From a Single Fund: SCHD
business.summary: A 60-year-old investor aims to collect $2,700 monthly from the Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF (SCHD), requiring approximately $1.1 million invested at the current yield. The article discusses the complexities of relying on a single fund for fixed income, including the impact of quarterly payment schedules and rising share prices on overall yield and budgeting.

business.title: 'High-beta turnaround opportunity': Jefferies sees up to 29% upside in Vodafone Idea stock
business.summary: Jefferies has initiated coverage on Vodafone Idea, describing it as a "high-beta turnaround opportunity" in the Indian telecommunications sector. The brokerage highlights factors such as accelerating revenue growth, operating leverage, and tariff-driven earnings expansion, projecting a potential upside of up to 29% for the stock. This assessment reflects confidence in the company's recovery trajectory and market potential.

business.title: U.S. suspends Cognizant’s green-card filings; IT industry may face tougher scrutiny
business.summary: The U.S. Department of Labor has suspended Cognizant Technology Solutions' and Cloudera's permanent labor certification filings due to an ongoing visa fraud investigation. This suspension affects the process for employers seeking employment-based green cards for foreign workers. The IT industry may face increased scrutiny as a result of these actions, potentially impacting hiring practices and immigration processes.

technology.title: Samsung rolls out 'Welcome to Foldables' video hours before Apple's event
technology.summary: Samsung has released a promotional video titled "Welcome to Foldables" just hours before Apple's event, which is expected to introduce Apple's entry into the foldable phone market. While September 9 holds little significance for Samsung, it is a crucial day for Apple as it aims to compete with Samsung's Flip and Fold 8 models in the foldable segment.

technology.title: Honor Magic 9 Series Launch Date Confirmed: Check Design, Camera And Expected Specs
technology.summary: Honor has announced that its flagship Magic 9 series will launch in China on September 28. The company is currently accepting pre-orders for the new smartphones in its home market. Details regarding the design, camera features, and expected specifications have been highlighted, generating anticipation for the upcoming release of this latest smartphone lineup.

technology.title: Apple's 'Surprise and Shine' iPhone 18 series launch event
technology.summary: Apple will unveil the iPhone 18 series at its 'Surprise and Shine' event on September 9, 2026, at 10:30 PM IST. This marks the first major product launch under new CEO John Ternus, who succeeds Tim Cook. Anticipation surrounds the event as consumers and analysts await details about the latest iPhone features and innovations.

sports.title: Sharmin Akhter: Can't dream of winning Asia Cup without having the belief to beat India
sports.summary: Bangladesh batter Sharmin Akhter emphasized the importance of belief in their ability to defeat India in the Asia Cup semi-final. Speaking to Cricbuzz, she stated that dreaming of becoming champions is impossible without confidence. Bangladesh secured their place in the semi-finals after a narrow victory over UAE, highlighting the significant challenge posed by the Indian team ahead.

sports.title: Bahrain’s win not enough, India on to the AVC Men's Volleyball Asian Championship quarterfinals in Fukuoka; watch this Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games and 2027 World Cup qualifier live on VBTV
sports.summary: India has advanced to the quarterfinals of the AVC Men's Volleyball Asian Championship in Fukuoka, despite Bahrain's victory. The quarterfinal match-ups include Thailand versus Australia and Iran against Chinese Taipei, scheduled for Thursday. The championship serves as a qualifier for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games and the 2027 World Cup, available for viewing on VBTV.

sports.title: Duleep Trophy final: Dominant East Zone solidify grip on title
sports.summary: East Zone dominated the Duleep Trophy final, finishing Day 4 with a lead of 584 runs. Skipper Ishan Kishan scored 80 runs, contributing to his match total of 350 runs. Alongside him, Shikhar Mohan also made a half-century. The team's strong performance has solidified their position in the tournament, showcasing their batting prowess throughout the match.

health.title: Suspected measles cases kill nearly 1,000 as Bangladesh struggles to contain outbreak
health.summary: Nearly 1,000 suspected measles deaths have been reported in Bangladesh, indicating a significant outbreak. The situation has worsened due to challenges in the vaccination program. Hospitals are overwhelmed with children suffering from the disease, including eight-month-old Rojatun Jannat Ramisa, who is struggling to breathe. Authorities are working to contain the outbreak and improve vaccination efforts.

health.title: Insilico's co-CEO hopes 'we might have a chance to stop biological aging'
health.summary: Insilico's co-CEO expressed optimism about potentially halting biological aging, aiming to alleviate Asia's healthcare challenges. The company claims to have early evidence supporting this possibility. However, a significant concern remains regarding the affordability and accessibility of these new medical technologies for millions. The focus is on ensuring that advancements in healthcare can be provided to the broader population.

health.title: Ebola virus spreads to new DRC health zone, WHO says
health.summary: The World Health Organization reported that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to the Kayna Health Zone in North Kivu province, increasing the total affected health zones to 61 across six provinces. Since May, over 6,600 Ebola cases have been recorded, resulting in 3,226 deaths. The situation remains critical.

science.title: Watch: Astrophotographer captures Roman telescope flying in space to its new home
science.summary: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope was observed as a small moving dot in a night-sky timelapse shortly after its launch. The telescope is en route to its new position nearly 1.6 million kilometers from Earth. Captured by an Arizona-based astrophotographer, this sighting highlights the telescope's journey as it travels to its designated location in space.

science.title: Meet Naidely Valeria Vidaurre-Quesada, the scientist who helped uncover a ghost shark species hiding in Costa Rica’s dark waters
science.summary: Naidely Valeria Vidaurre-Quesada, a scientist, played a key role in identifying a new ghost shark species in the deep waters off Costa Rica’s Pacific coast. The species, previously overlooked, was discovered among fish specimens stored in scientific collections for years. This finding highlights the importance of deep-sea research and the biodiversity present in these less-explored marine environments.

science.title: A huge dinosaur was uncovered at the Brazilian Rail project; here’s more about the study
science.summary: A significant dinosaur species was discovered during road rail construction in northeastern Brazil, contributing to ongoing debates about dinosaur existence and their traces. This finding provides new insights into the prehistoric era and the diversity of dinosaur species. Researchers are examining the remains to better understand the characteristics and habitat of this newly identified dinosaur.

entertainment.title: Arijit Singh says he will watch Bigg Boss for the first time because of Qazi Touqeer: ‘Apna rockstar hai udhar’
entertainment.summary: Singer Arijit Singh announced he will watch Bigg Boss for the first time, citing contestant Qazi Touqeer as his reason. Qazi has gained attention for his staged antics and is becoming a prominent figure in the house. His behavior, which includes centering conversations around himself and discussing his achievements, is resonating with viewers, evoking a sense of déjà vu.

entertainment.title: ChatGPT photo trend: Top 5 prompts to turn your photo into 1960s, 70s, 80s and 90s versions for Instagram, WhatsApp
entertainment.summary: A viral trend on social media allows users to transform their photos into nostalgic versions from the 1960s to the 1990s using AI tools like ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Grok. This phenomenon has gained popularity among celebrities and politicians, who are embracing the retro aesthetic. The process is straightforward, encouraging many to participate in this creative photo-editing trend.

entertainment.title: Shriya Pilgaonkar admits 'Mirzapur: The Movie' success was beyond expectations: 'Couldn’t have gauged this scale'
entertainment.summary: Actress Shriya Pilgaonkar has expressed her surprise at the success of 'Mirzapur: The Movie,' which has exceeded expectations at the box office, achieving a 100-crore milestone. This marks her first major success in cinema, transitioning from a focus on streaming projects. Pilgaonkar acknowledged that she could not have anticipated the film's scale and audience reception.
